technical-data.invention-title: HIGH VOLTAGE TRANSIENT VOLTAGE SURGE SUPPRESSION FUSE LINK SYSTEM
SYSTEME A FUSIBLES DE SUPPRESSION DE SURTENSION TRANSITOIRE HAUTE TENSION

abstract.p: Disclosed is a high voltage transient surge suppression system (1) which provides a fusing to greatly reduce or eliminate the chance of secondary combustion during an excess power situation. The invention (1) having a fuse link system which places one or more fuse links (10) between a first electrical potential (7, 8) and a second electrical potential (15, 16), and which uses air to insulate or isolate electrical potentials so that products of combustion from an excess power surge do not form a conductive path between electrical potentials on a printed circuit board (2).

La présente invention concerne un système (1) de suppression de tension transitoire haute tension présentant un fusible qui permet d'éliminer ou de réduire de manière importante le risque de combustion secondaire en cas d'excédent de puissance. En outre, ce système (1) à fusible place un ou plusieurs fusibles (10) entre un premier potentiel électrique (7, 8) et un second potentiel électrique (15, 16), et utilise l'air pour isoler les potentiels électriques de sorte que les produits de combustion provenant d'une surtension de puissance excédentaire ne forment pas de trajet conducteur entre les potentiels électriques sur une carte à circuit imprimés (2).

claim.claim-text: CLAIMS

1. A high voltage transient surge suppression system, comprising: a. a printed circuit board; b. a first electrical potential on the printed circuit board; c. one or more surge suppression devices each mounted on the printed circuit board and electrically connected to the first electrical potential; d. one or more fuse links each with a first fuse link end electrically connected to at least one of the one or more surge suppression devices, and with a second fuse link end electrically connected to a second electrical potential, the fuse links being sized to open when the associated surge suppression device fails or in an excess power surge condition; and wherein the one or more fuse links are suspended in air between the first fuse link end and the second fuse link end.
2. A high voltage transient surge suppression system as recited in claim 1, and wherein the first electrical potential is a power potential and the second electrical potential is a neutral potential.
